pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

- add exact-head Remote AI Studio browser visual validation using the real loopback gateway and production companion HTML/JS
- seed deterministic Agent Host state only under the `visual-validation` feature so proposal, Go/Stop, permission, progress, reconnect evidence, completion state, and captured-frame review are visible
- capture desktop, narrow, and mobile browser viewports plus tall companion evidence for below-the-fold review
- document the opt-in browser visual scenario without changing the trusted workflow boundary

## ADR0133 audit context

Current main already contains the Remote AI Studio lifecycle, HTTP/SSE, reconnect cursor, idempotency, exact-version Go, stale Stop/permission protection, captured frame retrieval, sanitized DTOs, and responsive companion from the merged #289 implementation and later integration work. The stale #291 branch is not reused as an implementation base.

## Validation

- Windows Validation on the exact final head
- Remote browser visual review at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths
